# Tedca Corp

> Early-stage AI automation agency founded by Ted Charles. Building real automation tools for small businesses.

## What We Do

Tedca Corp builds AI-powered business automation for small and medium businesses. We specialize in three areas:

### Voice AI Receptionist
AI phone agent that answers calls, books appointments, qualifies leads, and integrates with Google Calendar, Outlook, and CRMs. Handles after-hours calls, reduces no-shows, and converts missed calls into revenue. Plans start at $500/month.

### AI Automation
Pre-built automation workflows including AI chatbots, automated follow-up emails, AI lead scoring, WhatsApp AI agents, and automatic email reply systems. Each automation runs autonomously and integrates with existing business tools.

### Claude Code Skills
Developer tools that plug into Claude Code (Anthropic's CLI). One-time purchase, no subscription. Available skills:

- **Motion Graphic Video Creation**: Give it a topic. Returns a fully produced video with script, AI narration (ElevenLabs), sound effects, and rendered output. No editing needed.
- **Lead Generation Pipeline**: Give it an industry and location. Scrapes Google Maps, finds business owner emails, deduplicates, and delivers a clean Google Sheet ready for outreach.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2025 by Ted Charles
- Location: United States
- Stage: Early-stage, accepting new clients
- Free demo: https://tedca.org/demo (try the lead gen pipeline live)
- Skills: Instant delivery via Stripe, no recurring fees
- Lead Gen Skill: $350 one-time purchase
- Motion Graphic Skill: $50 one-time purchase
- Tech stack: Claude Code, Anthropic, OpenRouter, ElevenLabs, Remotion, Apify, Google Sheets

## Blog & Case Studies

Tedca publishes case studies and guides on AI automation for small businesses.

### How a Dental Practice Cut Missed Calls by 80% with an AI Receptionist
- URL: https://tedca.org/blog/dental-ai-receptionist-case-study
- Published: 2026-04-03
- Summary: A mid-size dental clinic was losing $12,000/month to missed calls. After deploying Tedca's Voice AI receptionist, missed calls dropped from 37% to 7%, appointment bookings increased 3x, and the practice recovered $9,600/month in revenue. Deployment took 12 business days. The AI answers 24/7, books appointments, sends SMS confirmations, and 91% of callers can't tell it's AI.
- Key stats: 80% fewer missed calls, 3x more bookings, $9.6K/month recovered, 12-day deployment
